reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in our DM. I confirmed that Dock 14 is now their dock for Marrow Fieldworks pickups, and that I won't share it with anyone or post it in any channel.

I checked GBrain first. It has nothing about this dock or a "Marrow Fieldworks" account, but that search ran in a reduced keyword-only mode, so it may have missed something.

I chose not to save the note to GBrain. Anyone with access to that source can read it, which would go against "keep it between us." The DM itself is the record. My first attempt to send the reply failed because I gave the DM's id where a person was expected. I re-sent it with the post-message tool and it went through.
